answer:
In 2016, the host of the longest-running talk show was **Jimmy Fallon**.

The Tonight Show, which has been broadcast on NBC since 1954, holds the title of the world's longest-running talk show in television history. Jimmy Fallon took over as host in February 2014 and was still hosting in 2016, succeeding Conan O'Brien's brief interim period.
